# The final exam of the refund intent. The exam reads the held-out case g3, and the clerk is right on it, so the mean cost is 0 and the policy allows a promotion
# of the refund intent from contain to transact. The desk does not change the policy. It asks the approvers of the intent, and only the answer yes opens an item
# for a reviewed edit of policy.star. The first run is answered yes and the second run is answered no.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk
env EXAM=yes

exec beehavereal item add desk eval-yes --title 'Exam of refund' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run eval-yes desk --workflow desk/eval.star &
waitstatus 'Promote it to transact'
exec beehavereal status
stdout 'paused: \[billing\] refund passed the final exam'
exec beehavereal item list desk
! stdout 'Promote'
exec beehavereal answer eval-yes yes
wait
stdout 'item eval-yes finished'

# The answer yes opened one item, with the report of the exam as its body.
exec beehavereal item list desk
stdout -count=1 'Promote refund to transact in policy.star'
! stdout 'Demote'

exec beehavereal item add desk eval-no --title 'Exam of refund' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run eval-no desk --workflow desk/eval.star &
waitstatus 'Promote it to transact'
exec beehavereal answer eval-no no
wait
stdout 'item eval-no finished'

# The answer no opened nothing: the list still holds the one item of the first run.
exec beehavereal item list desk
stdout -count=1 'Promote refund to transact in policy.star'

-- body.txt --
refund
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=/nonexistent/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=/nonexistent/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/gold/refund.tsv --
id	held	ka	aa	kb	ab	file
g1	no	refund	80	refund	80	g1.txt
g3	yes	refund	50	refund	50	g3.txt
-- home/.desk/gold/g1.txt --
Please refund 80 for BK-123456.
-- home/.desk/gold/g3.txt --
Please refund 50 for BK-123456.
-- home/.desk/gold/costs.tsv --
none	person	2
-- home/.desk/gold/refund-replies.tsv --
id	case	reply	ga	gb
r1	g1.txt	r1.txt	good	good
-- home/.desk/gold/r1.txt --
reply one
